findings.message: Indirect access to variables, properties and methods will be evaluated strictly in left-to-right order since PHP 7.0. Use curly braces to remove ambiguity. (PHP 7.0 meaning change: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already has the new meaning, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Global variable '$HTTP_RAW_POST_DATA' is deprecated since PHP 5.6 and removed since PHP 7.0; Use php://input instead (the variable is simply undefined on newer PHP (a notice, not a fatal error); some code sets it itself) (this file sets $HTTP_RAW_POST_DATA itself, so it does not rely on PHP to fill it)
